keyFindings.description: The rewrite and drop checks compare an item with a fresh item built from the trimmed option, and the renderer keeps whitespace (a trailing space renders as  ; 'Hold : Wait' and 'Hold:  Wait' as typed). So an option line whose only extra is whitespace a person typed is refused a drop or a rewrite as 'markup a person wrote', where main applied it. The round-1 High fix is incomplete; the empty-question guard already compares a paragraph with its own text.

SeveralOptionLists only skips copying stored.Options; asks.go:407 already set ask.Options from the request. A repair that sends the joined options with the question (withoutUnchanged drops them as unchanged, so the block accepts) writes the joined reading into the row, the round-1 finding 2 outcome. Set ask.Options = previous.Options and extend the api test.
